item.title: Governors arrive in Washington eager to push past Trump’s partisan grip

item.title: The travertine quarries that built ancient Rome are carving rock for a new generation of temples
item.description: TIVOLI, Italy (AP) — Long ago, when Romans wanted to build a new temple, they would head to the nearby quarries of Tivoli, chisel out blocks of porous rock called lapis tiburtinus — now known as travertine — and float the cargo downstream on rafts to craftsman in town.
